mostWorthwhile.text: Mounting the two drive units was most worthwhile: the separate motor-and-wheel assemblies became a recognizable wheeled base.

leastWorthwhile.text: Fitting the battery pack and receiver felt somewhat repetitive in text, though their separate placements were clear.
